name: Optimus G

Network.Technology: GSM (850 / 900 / 1800 / 1900), HSDPA, CDMA (Global 800 / 850 / 1900 & South Korea LG U+ Korean Pcs 1800), LTE

Platform.Operating system: Android 4.0.4 Ice Cream Sandwich , 4.1.2 Jelly Bean , 4.4.2 KitKat

Memory.RAM: 2 GB LPDDR2 RAM clocked at 533 MHz
Memory.Card slot: Not available in the Global models, microSD up to 64 GB AT&T & Japan & Taiwan

Cameras.Rear camera: 13.0(Global)/8.0(AT&T) megapixels (market/carrier dependent) Back-illuminated sensor, LED flash, HD video (1080p) at 30 frames/s, Time catch shot, smart shutter and cheese shutter, Simultaneous HD video and image recording, Smile and face detection, Image stabilization

Battery.Battery: Non-Removable Li-ion 2100 mAh (U.S, Canada, South Korea, Global variant) , Removable Li-ion 2210 mAh (Japan variant), Removable Li-ion 2280 mAh (Taiwan variant)

Connectivity.Connectivity: 3.5 mm stereo audio jack, Wi-Fi 802.11 a/b/g/n, Wi-Fi Hotspot, DLNA, Bluetooth 4.0 + A2DP, micro-USB 2.0 (5-pin) port with mobile high-definition video link (MHL) for USB or HDMI connection
